title: Referees on a resume: who to choose and how to list them
desc: Australian employers often call referees. Who to choose, how to ask them and how to list them on your resume.
blocks: In Australia, employers often call referees before making an offer. Choosing them well can make the difference at the last step.
A recent manager or supervisor is best.
A senior colleague who knows your work well.
For a first job: a teacher, coach or volunteer coordinator.
Always ask permission, tell them which job you applied for and what the employer may ask about. Give them a copy of your resume.

Name, job title, company, phone and email, plus how they know you (for example "my manager at Woolworths, 2022 to 2024"). If you prefer to keep their details private, write "Referees available on request".
